deliverables: Fund builders whose work can improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Continue and expand KPI tracking, including movement toward KPI tracking tied to live on-chain Cardano data.
Operate proposal evaluation, feedback coordination, transparent fund distribution, and result tracking for funded work.
Use an independent administrator/multisig to validate milestones before Cardano Builder DAO receives funds.
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury after completion.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with funds received and administered initially by an independent council/multisig composed of dRep DAO members before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal for the Cardano Builder DAO, described as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism to allocate capital to Cardano builders tied to ecosystem KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism for projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs such as monthly active users, monthly transactions, and TVL.
The proposal says funded projects will be required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions, with a goal of increasingly on-chain KPI verification.
The Cardano Builder DAO says it has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Round 1 is described as involving 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, 5,541,335 ADA distributed, and 83% governance participation.
Round 2 is described as adding 18 new members, funding 14 companies, and reaching 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

The proposal says the DAO created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based proposal review, and executed treasury withdrawals on-chain with transparency.

The proposal states that official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions.

The administrator is described as an independent council including Cardano Yoda, Marco Grendel Moshi, and one additional non-affiliated active dRep, with ADA held in auditable separate accounts, not delegated to an SPO, and delegated to abstain voting.

The proposal states all milestones will be disbursed from an independent multisig after administrator validation, and the Cardano Builder DAO receives funds only after milestone completion is validated and confirmed.
The CB DAO says it returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after its first two governance rounds, citing an AdaStat transaction link.

summary: The proposal requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue a KPI-oriented, smart contract-governed funding mechanism for Cardano builders, with milestone validation by an independent dRep DAO administrator and a stated repayment practice for unused funds.
